second_pass: The first emitted ASCII DXF is correctly refused as a new SUNSTUDY source under the current narrow profile even with observation enabled. The emitted NOD includes an additional ACAD_GROUP entry and the SUNSTUDY owner precedes its reactor; the present source guards admit exactly one root entry and reactor-before-owner. The same CLASS row is preserved. Generic preflight rejects duplicate or aliased ACAD_GROUP source roots, and the writer reserves and maps generated C/D identities. The SUNSTUDY selected-output inspector checks the SUNSTUDY edge only; it does not independently prove the added ACAD_GROUP output edge. A bounded successor requires exact source binding of the additional empty ACAD_GROUP dictionary and both root entries, an explicit owner-before-reactor source profile, a complete emitted edge proof, and output/rollback/readback tests. Do not relax the graph guards on the basis of this observation alone.
